title: Predicate preservation under preprocessing
statement: Let $T$ be a sign tester, let $\Psi$ be a set of sign predicates, and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. If every check selected by $T$ has its predicate in $\Psi$, then every check selected by the noise-preprocessed tester also has its predicate in $\Psi$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sign tester on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with finite seed space
$\Psi$ is a set of sign predicates
Every check selected by $T$ has its predicate in $\Psi$
